description: This file declares the WaylandScreenConnector class, which manages Wayland display connections and callbacks within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes methods for setting frame and display event callbacks, and holds a unique pointer to a WaylandServer instance.

classes.name: WaylandScreenConnector
classes.description: A class that manages Wayland display server interactions, including setting callbacks for frames and display events.

methods.name: SetFrameCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be invoked when a processed frame is generated.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to handle display events.
